prompt.es: Escribe el relato de tu entrevista y una autoevaluación breve.

answer.text: The panel asked me five questions. First, they wanted to know why I wanted the scholarship, and I explained my motivation. Second, I was asked to describe a time when I led a project. Third, they enquired about my plans for July and wanted to know whether I could travel. Then, they asked what I would do if the group did not agree. Finally, I was asked to name one weakness. Overall, I felt confident and calm during the interview. On reflection, my second answer was the best because it had a clear example. Next time I aim to improve my answer to the hypothetical question by adding a reason.
accepted: The panel asked me five questions. First, they wanted to know why I wanted the scholarship, and I explained my motivation. Second, I was asked to describe a time when I led a project. Third, they enquired about my plans for July and wanted to know whether I could travel. Then, they asked what I would do if the group did not agree. Finally, I was asked to name one weakness. Overall, I felt confident and calm during the interview. On reflection, my second answer was the best because it had a clear example. Next time I aim to improve my answer to the hypothetical question by adding a reason.

I had an interview for the scholarship, and the panel asked me five questions. They wanted to know why I wanted the scholarship, and then I was asked to describe a time when I led a project. They also enquired about July and asked if I could travel. After that, they wanted to know what I would do if the group did not agree, and I was asked to name one weakness. Overall, I was not nervous. Looking back, my answer about the project was the strongest because it gave an example. Next time I aim to improve my answer to the hypothetical question by giving a reason.

feedback.es: Un buen relato usa estilo indirecto con verbos variados (wanted to know, was asked to, enquired about) y cierra con una valoración y un objetivo de mejora.

origin.text: Te hicieron cinco preguntas en una entrevista para una beca: 1) por qué quieres la beca; 2) cuéntame una vez en que lideraste un proyecto; 3) si podías viajar en julio; 4) qué harías si el grupo no estuviera de acuerdo; 5) nombra un punto débil. Cuenta qué te preguntaron (estilo indirecto, en pasado) y termina con una autoevaluación: qué respondiste mejor y qué mejorarás.
